story: A young prince's robot, Raju Robo, starts malfunctioning. With his trusty Mac in hand, he adds a small robot to fix it.
script:
Enduku ra mechanical text books chustav, update avvu... Raju Robo, kool aipoindi!
Raju: Oka robot kuda join chesi, operation chusakapodam! 🔧🔩
Mac: OK, here's the plan - we need to rewire the circuits and reboot the system... and I've got my trusty friend mini robot here to help us fix the glitch!
Raju: Mini robot, kuda join cheyyam. Ee kuda vishal robot ka repair cheyam...🤖
Mini robot: Don't worry, Raju! I've got this. I'll plug myself right in and get the power flowing!
Raju: Enduku chustav! 🤩 Now let's see... Mac: Are you ready, Raju? Mini robot: Go go go!
Raju: Woah! Raju Robo, working again! 🎉💥
All: Yes!! Raju Robo is back online! 🔥💻
title: 🚀💻 RAJU ROBO KOOOLAYIPOYUNDI! 🤖 | Raja Ka Robot Ka Fix 💡 | Funny Robotics 🤔
